 Good to Have

 Why Obraz
 * Direct exposure to the CEO and the opportunity to shape product positioning.

* Own product marketing end\-to\-end and build the function from the ground up.
* Develop expertise in translating advanced AI engineering into enterprise buyer language.

title: Performance Marketing Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Kean.Club is a contemporary western wear brand focused on elevated everyday fashion for modern, style\-conscious customers. The brand blends modern silhouettes, refined detailing, and high\-quality fabrics to create pieces that feel both effortless and premium. Collections are designed to bridge the gap between trend and timelessness, offering versatile and flattering options for daily wear. As a growing startup, Kean.Club is driven by creativity, attention to detail, and a clear vision to build a distinctive premium fashion label.
 



  






 As a Performance Marketing Executive at Kean.Club, you will be responsible for planning, executing, optimizing, and scaling paid advertising campaigns across Meta and Google platforms.
 




  






 This is a results\-driven role.
 




  






 You will be measured on ROI, cost efficiency, lead quality, and campaign scalability — not just impressions or clicks.
 




  






 You will collaborate closely with Social Media Executive, Content Writer, Designers, and the Sales team to align paid campaigns with business goals.
 




  





 Requirements
 



  




* 1–4 years of hands\-on experience managing paid ad campaigns.
* Proven track record of generating leads, conversions, or sales through Meta and Google Ads.
* Strong understanding of full\-funnel performance strategy (TOF, MOF, BOF).
* Skills and measurable results matter more than formal education. Degree is not mandatory with proven performance outcomes.
* Experience managing campaign budgets and optimising for CPA/ROAS.
* Strong analytical ability and reporting discipline.


- 


 Responsibilities
 



  




* 1\. Campaign Strategy \& Setup Plan and execute campaigns on Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads. Structure campaigns based on business goals (lead generation, sales, awareness). Define targeting, creatives, and funnel strategy.
* 2\. Optimization \& Scaling Monitor daily performance and optimize campaigns. Improve CTR, reduce CPA, and increase ROAS. Conduct A/B testing for creatives, audiences, and copy. Scale winning campaigns strategically.
* 3\. Analytics \& Reporting Track campaign metrics including CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, and Conversion rate. Submit structured weekly performance updates. Prepare detailed monthly performance reports with insights and next\-step recommendations.
* 4\. Collaboration \& Funnel Alignment Work with content and design teams for ad creatives. Align landing pages with campaign objectives. Ensure tracking setup using Meta Pixel, Google Tag, and conversion tracking tools.
* 5\. Budget \& Performance Control Manage ad budgets responsibly. Monitor performance fluctuations and troubleshoot issues quickly. Ensure accurate tracking and attribution.



  





 Skills \& Qualifications
 



  




* Strong expertise in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
* Understanding of audience segmentation and retargeting strategies.
* Experience with conversion tracking setup.
* Analytical mindset with strong data interpretation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
* (Bonus) Experience with landing page optimization (CRO basics).
* (Bonus) Knowledge of Google Tag Manager.
* (Bonus) Experience running YouTube Ads.
* (Bonus) Understanding of lead nurturing funnels.
* (Bonus) Experience working in a digital marketing agency.


- 



 Key Performance Indicators
 




  




* Cost Per Lead (CPL) or Cost Per Acquisition (CPA)
* Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
* Conversion rate improvement
* Budget utilization efficiency
* Campaign scalability
* Reporting accuracy and timeliness

title: Email Marketing Specialist
description:
**About the role:** 




 Rocky Mountain Media is hiring an Email Marketing Specialist focused primarily on
 **generating qualified leads (b2b) through cold email outreach.** 
 This is a lead\-gen\-first role, your main job is filling our pipeline with prospects who convert into clients. You'll also support general administrative tasks, but email marketing and outreach performance is the core of what you're measured on.
 



**What you'll do:** 




*Email Marketing \& Lead Generation (primary focus):* 



* Build and run cold outreach campaigns end\-to\-end using
 **Apollo** 
 — list building, sequencing, sending, follow\-ups
* Own deliverability: mailbox warm\-up, sender reputation, domain health across multiple sending accounts, so campaigns actually land in inboxes
* Research and build targeted prospect lists based on our ideal client profile
* Write and continuously test email copy/subject lines/sequences to improve open and reply rates
* Manage replies and move interested prospects into the pipeline, coordinating scheduling through
 **Outlook**
* Track campaign performance (opens, replies, meetings booked, deals sourced) and report on what's working
* Continuously refine targeting and messaging based on results, this role owns outcomes, not just sending volume



*Administrative Support (secondary):* 



* Inbox and calendar coordination
* CRM/pipeline updates as leads move through the funnel
* General ad hoc administrative tasks as needed



**Compensation structure:** 



* Base pay for day\-to\-day outreach and admin work
* **Commission on any contract that closes from a lead you generated,** 
 structure to be discussed, but this role has real upside tied directly to outbound performance, not just activity



**What we're looking for:** 



* **Strong, hands\-on Apollo experience is essential,** 
 this is a lead\-gen role first, and Apollo is the core tool. We need someone who already knows how to build sequences, manage deliverability, and read campaign data, not someone learning it on the job
* Proficiency with
 **Outlook** 
 for scheduling and correspondence
* Strong written communication, you're writing the copy that gets replies, so this needs to be a real strength, not an afterthought
* Motivated by outcomes, since commission is tied to closed contracts, we're looking for someone who wants outreach performance to translate directly into their own income
* **Bonus:** 
 experience with
 **GoHighLevel (GHL)**



**Ideal candidate mindset:** 




 Someone who treats cold outreach as a numbers\-and\-optimization game, not just a task to complete, testing, iterating, and genuinely caring about reply and close rates because their own commission depends on it.

 established and growing New Zealand businesses. The portfolio spans financial services, property, home improvement, consumer products, technology and other commercial activities. Specific business information will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Develop and execute performance\-marketing strategies across multiple New Zealand businesses.
 



 • Plan, launch, manage and optimise Meta Ads across Facebook and Instagram.
 



 • Manage or coordinate Google Ads, landing pages, remarketing and conversion campaigns.
 



 • Take ownership of advertising budgets and allocate spend based on performance.
 



 • Monitor and improve CPL, CPA, CTR, ROAS, conversion rates and lead quality.
 



 • Build prospecting, retargeting, lookalike and full\-funnel campaigns.
 



 • Test creatives, copy, audiences, offers and landing pages continuously.
 



 • Ensure Meta Pixel, Conversion API, GA4 and conversion tracking are correctly implemented.
 



 • Coordinate designers, video editors, content creators, developers and freelancers.
 



 • Recruit, coordinate and manage additional digital\-marketing resources when required.
 



 • Review campaign performance daily and make decisions without waiting for constant instructions.
 



 • Maintain a clear marketing plan for each business and provide concise daily updates plus detailed
 



 weekly/monthly reports.
 



 • Identify weak campaigns quickly and take corrective action.
 



 • Understand the full journey from advertisement to lead to appointment to sale.
 



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 




 Experienced. Analytical. Commercially minded. Accountable.
 



 • A genuine hands\-on Meta Ads specialist with strong commercial judgement.
 



 • A wise, confident decision\-maker who can work independently and take responsibility for results.
 



 • Comfortable managing several businesses simultaneously.
 



 • Capable of leading staff, freelancers and specialist contractors.
 



 • Highly organised, proactive and strong in problem\-solving.
 



 • Confident communicating directly with management in New Zealand.
 



 • Focused on qualified leads, appointments and revenue \- not vanity metrics such as likes and followers.
 



  





**Essential Experience** 




 • Ideally 5\+ years of hands\-on digital/performance marketing experience.
 



 • Strong proven experience with Meta Ads Manager and lead\-generation campaigns.
 



 • Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets and improving CPL/CPA/ROAS.
 



 • Strong knowledge of Meta Ads, retargeting, remarketing, Pixel, Conversion API, GA4, Google Tag
 



 Manager, conversion tracking, A/B testing, landing\-page optimisation, CRM/lead funnels and reporting.
 



 • Experience managing multiple brands, client accounts or business verticals.
 



 • Previous team\-lead, agency or operational\-management experience is highly preferred.
 



  





**How Success Will Be Measured** 




 Qualified leads generated \- Cost per lead \- Cost per qualified appointment \- Lead quality \- Conversion rate \- Campaign ROI / ROAS \- Appointments generated \- Growth in enquiries \& sales
 



  





**What We Offer** 




 • Significant responsibility and freedom to implement good ideas.
 



 • Opportunity to build and lead the marketing team.
 



 • Long\-term career growth as the India\-based delivery team expands.
 



 • Competitive salary based on experience and demonstrated capability.
 



 • Performance incentives may be considered for measurable results.
 



  





**Employment Details** 




 Role Location: Kerala, India

 Ideal Candidate: A serious long\-term team member \- not someone looking for a short\-term role
 



 or freelance side project.
 



  





**HOW TO APPLY**

 1\. Updated CV
 



 2\. Years of Meta Ads / performance\-marketing experience

**Please also answer:**

title: Social Media & Campaign Manager

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
We're looking for a hands\-on Marketing Coordinator who's equally comfortable out in the field and behind a phone. This is a hybrid role: part of your week is spent on the ground, managing distribution of flyers, running local activations, and talking to real customers, and part is spent building our presence online through social media and local influencers. If you like variety, you're organized, and you're motivated by seeing your work turn into actual foot traffic and followers, this is for you.
 



 What you'll do
 



**On the ground** 



* Plan and run door\-to\-door and local flyer campaigns, and identify the neighborhoods, spots, and events worth targeting
* Represent the brand at pop\-ups, local events, and community activations
* Track which locations and tactics actually drive traffic, and adjust based on what's working



**Social \& influencer** 



* Find, reach out to, and manage relationships with local micro\-influencers and content creators
* Coordinate posts, collaborations, and content, including negotiating small paid or barter deals
* Help create and schedule content across our social channels
* Monitor reach, engagement, and results, and report back on what's landing



 What we're looking for
 


* Comfortable being out in the field and starting conversations with strangers
* Organized enough to juggle multiple campaigns, creators, and deadlines at once
